bullets.text: Apple Appeals £1.5 Billion Case - **Apple** seeks to overturn a ruling on excessive App Store commissions affecting millions of UK customers.
Meta Acquires Manus AI - **Meta** purchases the AI startup Manus for $2 billion, enhancing its AI capabilities.
LG Launches Gallery TV - **LG** enters the art TV market with its new Gallery TV, featuring a subscription service for art displays.
Apple Wallet Upgrades - **Apple Wallet** introduces order tracking and Digital ID features in iOS 26, enhancing user experience.
Amazfit Active Max Unveiled - The **Amazfit Active Max** smartwatch offers a month-long battery life at a competitive price.
AI's 2025 Reality Check - The AI industry faces scrutiny as concerns about sustainability and investment bubbles emerge.
Samsung Integrates Google Photos - **Samsung** plans to bring **Google Photos** to its TVs, enhancing user photo experiences.
Windows on Arm Improves - **Windows on Arm** laptops see enhanced performance and compatibility, making them more viable.
AI Adoption Predicted to Rise - VCs anticipate significant **enterprise AI** adoption in 2026, despite previous struggles.
GOG Splits from CD Projekt - **GOG** co-founder acquires the platform, reaffirming its commitment to DRM-free gaming.
